season.evidence: Stored text says mid-to-late summer once the burn slopes, ridge and Coney Lake basin are clear; a route page and a Mountaineers page agree early-season attempts mean steep snow/couloir. Peakbagger ascents of the peak by any route peak Jun-Oct (Aug 98, Sep 80).

otherTracksConsidered.why: Logged NW ridge/standard; line gains the north-west ridge via the Mountaineer Creek forest, then continues to Enchantment Peak (link-up). Not the NE ridge above Coney Lake.
Report calls it the NW ridge; line climbs the west side from the Stuart Lake trail, not the NE crest, and descends via Prusik Pass.
Blank logged route; line is the west/NW ridge, then continues to Enchantment Peak (link-up).
Report describes a west-ridge line (Mountaineer Creek gullies to a flat basin at ~6100 ft then the W ridge), not the NE ridge.
Logged SW ridge; same west-side line, and June 1 is offseason anyway.
May 22 and a four-peak link-up; NW ridge anyway.

May 24. The report (landslide slopes, ridge, option to drop toward Coney Lake, north couloir) does match our NE ridge/couloir variation, but May is two months before the season. Also exits via the Enchantments.
June 10 north couloir/NW ridge snow climb that is a multi-peak link-up (Enchantment group); no assignment.
Prusik Pass/Druid Plateau approach, not NE ridge.

notes: Most Peakbagger tracks climb the west/NW ridge from the Stuart Lake trail via Mountaineer Creek; we hold no route by that name (stored: Northeast Ridge and South Slopes only), so a NW/West Ridge route may be worth adding. South Slopes already has a track.
